title: The Paper Trail
subtitle: Abu Ghraib & the Chain of Authorisation
abstract: GSS Anarchive · Collection 06. Abu Ghraib is filed in public memory as a photography scandal. It was a paperwork scandal. This counter-archive contains no photographs and follows the memoranda instead — twelve documents in a chain of authorisation from the 2002 Bybee memo through Rumsfeld's December 2002 signature and the 'GTMOization' of Iraq in August 2003, into the hard site at Tier 1A, out through the Taguba report and the 2004 broadcast, and ending in the 2026 Fourth Circuit affirmance of Al Shimari v. CACI. Design conceit: the memo, not the photograph — the signature device is a redaction bar the reader must lift by hand. Includes an accountability-by-rank ladder (Cabinet: no charges → enlisted: prison), nine case files, and standing ethical rules.
